reason: The whole thing rests on follower counts and results the creators report themselves, and the page even says nobody has verified them. I'm not putting $525 in escrow for one Reel when I can just mail free product to micro-creators and see what happens.
objection: How do I know their followers are real? Escrow protects me from a no-show, not from paying $500 to someone with 40,000 bought followers who drives zero sales.
would_change_my_mind: Follower and engagement numbers pulled straight from Instagram/TikTok and verified, plus a way to offer free product or a small cash-plus-product deal instead of $500 up front.
